title: Austin Inauguration & New Leadership
summary:
*   **New Leaders Sworn In:** Newly elected council members for Places Two, Five, and Six took their oaths of office.
*   **Mayor Pro Tem Position Filled:** The council voted unanimously to select a Mayor Pro Tem for the new term.
*   **Key Absences Noted:** The Mayor and one other council member were not present for this special meeting, which included the swearing-in ceremony and leadership selection.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
SATURDAY, JUNE 15, 2002
INVOCATION - Reverend Joe Parker, David Chapel Missionary Baptist Church
1. Administer the Oath of Office to the newly elected Mayor, Council Members for Place Two,
Place Five, and Place Six of the City Council.
The Honorable Judge Gisela Triana, Travis County Court-at-Law No. 5 administered
the oath of office to Council Members Dunkerley, Goodman and Slusher.
Mayor Pro Tern Goodman called the meeting to order at 6:21 p.m.
2. Selection of Mayor Pro Tern
A motion was made to as Mayor Pro Tern on Council Member Slusher's motion,
Council Member Dunkerley's second by a 5-0 vote. 
Mayor Garcia and Council
Member Alvarez were absent.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 7:00 p.m. was approved on Council Member
Slusher's motion, Council Member Wynn's second by a 5-0 vote. 
Mayor Garcia and
Council Member Alvarez were absent.
